items.information: ![](https://scontent-cpt1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.6435-9/70003471_108441357202077_8755966770554077184_n.png?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=09cbfe&_nc_ohc=4aN2V_lEohoAX88_D58&_nc_ht=scontent-cpt1-1.xx&oh=00_AT88cgqdTcPLuaRfyObJPcGUGy_nPtp6qvOKegZxah6Ijg&oe=62E91A2B) ![](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/img/speedcubes-logo-1630492151.jpg) Register for the first WCA Speedcubing Competition in Paarl, near Cape Town, South Africa! **COVID-19 Safety Measures** While it is no longer a national requirement to wear a face mask or practice social distancing, we encourage you to sanitize regularly and be respectful of personal space. If you are comfortable wearing a mask, please do so! **Volunteering** We will need your help as volunteers to support with the running and judging of the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact [Maverick Pearson](mpearson@worldcubeassociation.org). Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing. **Cube Shop** Cape Town's own cube shop, [Speedcubes.co.za](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/), will have a stall open at the competition to sell a variety of puzzles. Check out their website to see what's available! **Zero-waste Tuck Shop** There will be a tuck shop open near the school hall with healthy and tasty snacks, coffee, and drinks. There will also be a lunch option that can be booked beforehand. We will share the link to this booking closer to the day via email.

items.information: This competition is a series competition with [Marshall Middle Slice 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarshallMiddleSlice2022/). Registrants will only be accepted to one competition. If you are under the age of 18 by the date of the competition, your parents will need to fill out a minor waiver form. This form will be sent to the competitor's email closer to the date of the competition. This competition is hosted by West Coast Cubing. ![This competition is hosted by West Coast Cubing.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png)

items.information: 8/21に行われる[Yoga Summer A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerA2022) (以下、A大会) と8/28に行われるYoga Summer B 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、B大会**) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (2ラウンド) / ピラミンクス / 3x3x3 目隠し / 4x4x4 目隠し / 5x5x5 目隠し **B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 2x2x2 キューブ / 4x4x4 キューブ / メガミンクス** 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。 競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。** また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。 [Yoga Summer A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerA2022) (A) and Yoga Summer B 2022 (**This competition, B**) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. A: 3x3x3 Cube (2 round) / Pyraminx / 3x3x3 blindfolded / 4x4x4 blindfolded / 5x5x5 blindfolded **B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 2x2x2 Cube / 4x4x4 Cube / Megaminx** The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. **Spectators are only permitted as companions of competitors.** Being mindful of space, we require that **each competitor bring at most 1 guest.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors)
